annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/2713 of 5 December 2023 designating European Union reference laboratories in the field of in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2023/2713 of 5 December 2023 designating European Union reference laboratories in the field of in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation designating EU reference laboratories under the In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation (EU) 2017/746 for hepatitis/retrovirus, herpesvirus, bacterial and respiratory virus test devices. Applies from 1 October 2024 for performance verification and batch testing tasks in conformity assessment. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Designates laboratories in Germany, Spain and Sweden as EU reference laboratories for four IVD scopes.
Enters into force on the third day after publication in the Official Journal.
Tasks under Article 100(2) of Regulation 2017/746 apply from 1 October 2024.
Reference labs perform performance verification only for devices with conformity assessment applications lodged from 1 October 2024.
Class D devices undergo performance verification and batch testing by EU reference laboratories.
